command:
cd /home/emp/Documents/VAC/vac-web && set +e && \
  echo '=== typecheck ===' && pnpm typecheck 2>&1 | tail -2 && \
  echo '=== architecture ===' && node scripts/check-architecture-boundaries.mjs 2>&1 | tail -1 && \
  echo '=== capability coverage ===' && node scripts/check-capability-coverage.mjs 2>&1 | tail -1 && \
  echo '=== slo budgets ===' && node scripts/check-slo-budgets.mjs 2>&1 | tail -1 && \
  echo '=== slo measurements smoke ===' && cargo run -p perf --quiet -- --duration 1 --output /tmp/perf-smoke2.json 2>&1 | tail -1 && node scripts/check-slo-measurements.mjs /tmp/perf-smoke2.json --strict 2>&1 | tail -1 && \
  echo '=== fmt ===' && cargo fmt --all -- --check 2>&1 | tail -1 && \
  echo '=== verify-codegen ===' && bash scripts/verify-codegen.sh 2>&1 | tail -1 && \
  echo '=== extension-trust gate ===' && node scripts/check-extension-trust.mjs 2>&1 | tail -1
